t: Bosch multi-tool blade with Starlock mount for maximum power transfer and fast blade changes. Designed for smooth, precise plunge cutting in softwood, cutting recesses in furniture components and flush cutting in wooden components. Tapered-based body offers minimised jamming and fast material removal, with laser-etched depth gauge. Curved-Tec rounded edge provides controlled, clean plunge cuts. Features colour-coding for easy blade identification.
